observed_value: fair_value_currency populated as CAD/EUR/GBP on 11 rows

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Header separates Par Amount /Units from Cost (3) and Fair Value columns.

findings.detail: The non-USD token belongs to the Par Amount /Units column; the following Cost and Fair Value amounts are valuation columns and should remain USD-denominated.

rationale: FX02 is a true data defect. The March 2025 investment schedule header has separate Par Amount /Units, Cost, and Fair Value columns. In the cited rows, CAD, EUR, and GBP appear in the par/unit column immediately before the cost and fair value amounts, not as the fair-value currency. The pipeline therefore carried the par/unit currency into fair_value_currency for the flagged fair value facts.
